task.title: Review an archived profile
task.shortdesc: Open an archived profile deliberately with archived context before restore or permanent delete decisions.

prereq.p: The archived profile is still visible through a Library lifecycle filter or an include_deleted route.

context.p: Archived profiles can be reviewed through include-deleted routes and Library lifecycle filters, but they are not normal active editing/export targets.

step.cmd: Set the Library lifecycle filter to Archived or All states.

info.p: Expected result: archived lifecycle context remains visible before any restore or destructive action.

step.cmd: Confirm the archived badge, profile name, schema channel, validation state, and update time before opening the row.

info.p: Expected result: archived lifecycle context remains visible before any restore or destructive action.

step.cmd: Open the archived profile only when you need review context, restore planning, comparison, or a deletion decision.

info.p: Expected result: archived lifecycle context remains visible before any restore or destructive action.

step.cmd: Restore the profile before normal editing/export, or cancel if the archived context is not the intended target.

info.note: Archived profile actions can affect profiles that are intentionally hidden from the normal active Library view.

result.p: You review the archived profile with its lifecycle context visible and avoid treating it as an active profile by mistake.

postreq.p: Recovery: if a bookmarked archived route reports Profile not found, return to the Library with archived profiles included and reopen from the visible row.
